verses.text: My spirit is broken. My days are almost over, and the grave is waiting for me.
Mockers surround me. I have to watch them insult me.
God, please promise to help me yourself. Who else will make a promise for me?
You have closed their minds to understanding, so you will not let them win.
If someone turns against his friends for a reward, his children will suffer for it.
God has made me a joke among the people. They spit in my face.
My eyes have grown dim with sadness. My whole body is as thin as a shadow.
Honest people are shocked at this. The innocent are upset with the godless.
But good people keep going on the right way, and those with clean hands grow stronger and stronger.
But all of you, come back and try again! I will not find a wise man among you.
My days are over. My plans have been broken, and so have the desires of my heart.
These men turn night into day. They say, 'Light is near,' when it is dark.
If the only home I hope for is the grave, if I make my bed in the darkness,
if I say to the pit, 'You are my father,' and to the worm, 'You are my mother' or 'my sister,'
then where is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?
Will my hope go down with me to the gates of the grave? Will we go down together into the dust?"
